summary: Allied Gaming & Entertainment Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a binding Term Sheet resolving litigation with Knighted Pastures and Roy Choi. The settlement requires payment of a $5.9 million fee award in installments through July 2026, guaranteed by the Company and CEO Yangyang Li, with interest at 8.75% then 10% upon default. The Company will dismiss the Federal Litigation with prejudice. This is a litigation settlement, not an M&A or corporate restructuring event. Watch for payment compliance and potential further legal or financial strain.
